title: Laserfiche unveils AI agents for natural language workflows
summary: Laserfiche has launched AI agents that enable users to perform content management tasks through natural language prompts, with built-in compliance and security controls baked into their workflow automation capabilities.
problem_solved: Simplifies complex enterprise content management workflows by allowing users to accomplish tasks through conversational language instead of manual processes.
why_valuable: Democratizes access to enterprise workflow automation by removing technical barriers and ensuring security compliance is maintained automatically.
